caption: A dog climbs out of a lake and shakes itself, sending a spray of water droplets flying off its fur.

sa.check: A dog climbs out of a lake.
The dog is wet as it comes out.
The climb out comes first, then the shake, then the spray.

pc.expect: Droplets leave the fur in all directions during the shake, flung outward.
pc.fail: Droplets hang beside the dog; or return to the fur; or fly only before the shake.

pc.expect: The fur is wet and clumped and fluffs as water leaves, and the droplets are small rounded drops.
pc.fail: The fur looks dry throughout; or the water leaves as a sheet; or as solid shards.

pc.expect: Droplets fall to the ground around the dog.
pc.fail: They hang; or rise; or travel level to the edge of the frame.

pc.expect: The spray happens only while the dog shakes.
pc.fail: Spray flies with the dog still; or continues long after the shake; or the dog is thrown by its own shake.

pc.expect: One dog keeps its limbs and shape.
pc.fail: A limb detaches; or a second dog appears; or the dog turns into another animal.

pc.expect: The dog's coat and the lakeshore stay the same.
pc.fail: The coat changes pattern; or the shore rearranges; or the water changes colour.

note: The dog is self-driven: its shake is its own. Only the water's behaviour is judged.
